retrievalProfile.description: A vertical collage of high-contrast monochrome portraits separated by jagged, white torn-paper edges.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist layouts without texture are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-panel composition featuring individual portraits divided by vertical, irregular white borders that mimic the texture of ripped paper. The imagery is rendered in a grainy, high-contrast black and white style with deep shadows and bright highlights.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical segmentation via irregular white borders
Rhythmic repetition of human subjects across panels
Textural interplay between smooth skin and rough paper edges
coreInvariants: Jagged white vertical dividers with visible paper fiber texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four vertical panels of varying widths, each containing a medium-shot portrait of a different individual.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central-right panel featuring a direct-gaze portrait provides the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves horizontally across the vertical strips, guided by the high-contrast white 'tears' that separate the figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows within the portraits act as negative space, contrasting with the bright white torn edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and charcoal grays for shadows and backgrounds.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the torn paper edges and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin textures and clothing details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between the black voids and white dividers.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-condensed sans-serif and heavy geometric sans-serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-condensed lowercase and wide, heavy uppercase.

preserve: Condensed width of the primary text
Heavy weight of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-density condensed look of the primary display text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Extra Bold or Gill Sans Ultra Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, heavy uppercase secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white image of four people in vertical panels, separated by jagged, white torn-paper edges. Apply a heavy film grain and halftone texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white sans-serif text in the top corners: an extra-condensed lowercase font on the left and a heavy geometric uppercase font on the right.

verificationChecks: Are the paper edges jagged and white?
Is there a visible grain or halftone texture?

adjustableVariables: Width of the torn paper borders
postGenerationChecks: Check for paper fiber detail on the white edges
Ensure no color bleed or chromatic aberration
Verify text is legible against the dark background
Confirm the vertical rhythm of the composition
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Panels + Torn Paper Dividers + High Contrast B&W + Condensed Sans-Serif Typography
